audit.whatIsWrong: Four chart rows read 'Skill' while their own whys named a winner: whys[2] says level 3 is Garen's, whys[3] says 4-5 flip to Illaoi, whys[5] says first item flips back to Garen, whys[6] calls 2+ items a skill check. The enums did not follow.
audit.why: Packet chart and the audited mirror both read Garen/Garen/Garen/Illaoi/Illaoi/Garen/Skill.
audit.corrected: Rows 3, 4-5, first item and 2+ items flipped in both layers with matching ratings, as one atomic group. The prose was already correct and needed no change.

audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item phase claimed Iceborn Gauntlet as an Illaoi spike against Garen with no caveat.
audit.why: Decisive Strike breaks free of all slows affecting him (Riot's own text), so the Iceborn slow — the reason the item is bought here, to make tentacles land — is cleansed on an 8s cooldown.
audit.corrected: phases[5].why now states that his Q clears the Iceborn slow, which is why first item swings to Garen.

audit.whatIsWrong: The cooldown and interaction blocks said only 'his silence opens his trade, bait it' — no number, and the two decisive interactions were absent.
audit.why: Decisive Strike is a flat 8s that silences AND breaks all slows on him; Leap of Faith makes Illaoi untargetable through the slam, so a Demacian Justice cast into it is wasted. Courage is 22s at rank 1 and grants tenacity plus a shield.
audit.corrected: All three written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, whys[4] and the level-6 framing.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[1] said Garen spins Judgment 'between tentacles for sustain' — Judgment has no sustain in Riot's text and Perseverance is out-of-combat regen only.
audit.why: Asserting healing that does not exist misprices the trade.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the real thing he wants: Q to break your slows and walk out of the tentacle field.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Garen must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Level 3 is his: Judgment is 9s at rank 1 and his passive regen refunds your chip, so give him nothing outside your tentacles.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Decisive Strike's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Your window at last: Decisive Strike is a flat 8s, so trade the moment he spends it, land E and W-stick him in the tentacles.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Decisive Strike's cooldown.
edits.after: First item swings back to him — Decisive Strike breaks free of the Iceborn slow, so it buys less here.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Garen carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: A skill check now: clean fights on tentacles are yours, a silenced Test of Spirit hands him the true-damage execute.

edits.before: - Garen Decisive Strike: matchup-defining — His silence opens his trade. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Decisive Strike (Q): flat 8s, silences and breaks every slow on him — bait it before you cast Test of Spirit. - Courage (W): 22s at rank 1, shield plus tenacity. - Judgment (E): 9s. - Leap of Faith: 120s, kill windows only.

edits.before: His silence opens his trade. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Decisive Strike is a flat 8s silence — bait it, then cast E in the gap.

edits.before: Track Garen's Decisive Strike (Silence): His silence opens his trade. Bait it. When it is down — Slam him in your field.
edits.after: Leap of Faith makes you untargetable through the slam, so a Demacian Justice cast into it is wasted. Q clears your slows.

edits.before: Level 6 stays yours as R Demacian Justice does nothing against your swarm.
edits.after: Level 6 is yours: Leap of Faith's slam is untargetable, so his execute whiffs.

edits.before: Spin E Judgment between tentacles for sustain
edits.after: Q to break your slows and leave the tentacles

notes: Two facts this page was missing. First: Decisive Strike breaks free of all slows on him, which is why Iceborn Gauntlet — bought specifically so tentacles land — buys much less in this matchup. Second: Leap of Faith's slam is untargetable, so Demacian Justice cast into it is wasted; that is the level-6 window. Also killed the invented claim that Judgment gives Garen sustain.
